question: What is the meaning of ratings or certificates in general in relation to official (mandated) indicators and certificates?
description: Ratings or certificates in general serve the purpose of verifying and certifying the quality of a building through objective third-party verification. They enable objective comparisons between buildings, act as a marketing tool, and can be linked to official indicators within building certification systems to provide automated assessments.
